description: Rust CAW: runs every agent command inside gVisor as a user that is not root, after the kernel dock of the Base Node admitted a sealed ping. Profiles, egress policies and toolsets come from GAP.

actions.description: List the profiles that caw.toml allows
Open a session on a workspace under one profile
Run one command in the gVisor sandbox of a session
Check caw.toml, the profiles, the pinned runsc and the kernel dock

cca.summary: Rust CAW with gVisor: every agent command runs in a sandbox under a GAP profile after the kernel admitted a sealed ping.
use_when: coding agents or shell workloads on a Linux host
confining tool commands of an agent to a workspace
pairing with the EDE for coding agents
avoid_when: hosts that are not Linux on amd64
